correctness.rationale: The metric-MMD graph and published vertex-cover correspondence imply an exact independent-set problem; even-cycle components reduce to crown graphs, odd-cycle configurations reduce to a 3-state transfer plus q−1 singleton color modes. The strict run-replacement inequality for q>=3 classifies maxima, and the cycle-cover combinatorics identifies forcing sets. All boundary cases q=n=3 or n=3<q are explicit. The packaged exact independent-definition verifier passes all nine test graphs, all coefficients, and small forcing cases; finite tests are not used as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Counts every admissible strong landmark set at every cardinality, not only a scalar minimum. Classifies all optimum placements and reveals a parity-sensitive forcing law with a genuine 3x3 exception. This answers a natural redundancy/rigidity question for a two-parameter family of clique-cycle networks; it is not a mere restatement of the known product dimension bound.
